success_criteria.quality: Full-budget public val_bpb must improve by at least 0.0015 against a nearby same-host exact 35c9 control after all exactness gates pass.
success_criteria.throughput: Unprofiled warmed whole-step median must improve by at least 3%, including index extraction, duplicate reduction, clipping, collectives, lazy decay, and row writes.
success_criteria.correctness: Across the exact four-table geometry, one joint rank-local clip coefficient covers all table gradients. The software-defined FP32 and BF16 oracles bit-exactly match deterministic dense AVG plus RMSProp, but the BF16 oracle does not establish native rounding order. Untouched parameter and physical lazy state bytes do not change; deterministic replay and serialize/reload/next-update pass. Offline checks establish only byte-identical 35c9/prepare source and an unchanged strict-load expression. A future authenticated native probe must strict-load the same real checkpoint through both paths and compare exact model keys, table bytes, and logits; no crash, NaN, causality, or budget failure.

abort_conditions: The backward path materializes or scans the full dense table gradient.
Any sparse COO, custom autograd side effect, hook, collective, unique/sort, index_add/scatter, or dynamic-shape primitive is unsupported or silently host-falls back on the pinned native SDK.
Local clipping before AVG is not reproduced exactly.
Duplicate reduction or rank merge is nondeterministic.
The native BF16 occurrence accumulation, joint clipping, all-reduce SUM/AVG rounding order, or resulting update differs from a captured dense native control.
Deferred beta2 decay or global bias correction differs from dense RMSProp.
Untouched table parameters change, or logical optimizer state differs from dense RMSProp.
Checkpoint model keys, load_for_eval behavior, logits, causality, or scoring path changes.

The future authenticated native component probe does not strict-load one real checkpoint through control and candidate and establish identical key sets, n-gram table bytes, and logits on predeclared inputs.
Whole-step throughput gain is below 3% or final BPB gate fails.
Any training, SSH, submission, or AWS action occurs before independent verification and separate human run approval.
